description: This PHP class defines a validation rule for checking entries related to deleted timesheet entries in the OrangeHRM system. It validates that an array of entries contains exactly two keys ('projectId' and 'activityId'), ensures these IDs are numeric and greater than zero, and confirms the overall structure of each entry.

classes.name: TimesheetDeletedEntriesParamRule
classes.description: A validation rule class that extends AbstractRule to validate the structure and content of timesheet deletion entries.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks whether the provided entries array conforms to the expected structure, with specific keys and valid numeric IDs.
